title: Split the docs and review the code
summary: The run split the docs into one doc for each part: overview, state, extension, runtime, flow, timeline, network-and-environment, agent-runs, recorder-and-notes and generator-and-release. It wrote docs/inputs.json (your 78 messages and 51 comment threads, cleaned: 71 kept, 20 merged, 38 removed, 15 knowledge summaries), docs/vision.md and docs/review-report.md. It removed 35 lines of unused CSS and an unused variable, and fixed a save during a draft that could undo a new version, the test times in gen/performance.json and the docs view; .claude/CLAUDE.md is short now. All 24 tests pass and the commit is 607ee24 (v48).
actions: Read docs/review-report.md and choose which proposals to do: A (a smaller state), B and C (a faster runtime), D and E (split the code), F (one md parser).
Make the choice about the microphone. It is still open.
